violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at the start of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Shaker bottles of toppings at service line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS discussed to label all bottles at service line with contents.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers (rainbow sprinkles) were observed reused for the storage of toppings (peanuts, graham crackers, sprinkles, etc).
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Please obtain reusable containers for topping storage,

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were for SPRINKLES observed reused for the storage of cookie crumbs, other donut toppings.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Discussed container usage with PIC.
